Incremental capacity signals lender support and stronger receivables base tied to higher prices.
Long-dated maturity lowers refinancing overhang; stability for liquidity planning.
Secures remaining proceeds under the LGA, supporting MaxSAF progress without equity raise.
Lower remaining spend reduces funding risk versus prior $1.2B plan.
